[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

[[Category:Adams County, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
James was born in 1827. He was the son of [[Glasgow-193|James Glasgow]] and [[McNeil-3468|Mary McNeil]]. He passed away in 1909.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-193]] is assessed at 85% (probable). James W.’s 1827 birth and the full couple James M. Glasgow/Mary McNeil fit the established household. The held 1887 Washington County, Iowa biography independently names the same parents for Robert Anderson, James W.’s recorded brother, supporting this family placement.

Probable extension of the documented family, not a claim that the biography itself names James W. as a son.

Next useful test: Find James W.’s own marriage, death or estate entry naming James M. and Mary.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2183 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-2183]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
